title: Remove dead isShabbos/isYomTov/formatHebrewDate from HebrewCalendarUtils (superseded by zmanim_window_service)
rule: Evans lens (ubiquitous language re-derived, not enforced in one place) + dead code

evidence.quote: /// For precise zmanim (sunset/nightfall), use ComplexZmanimCalendar with a GeoLocation.

why: `grep -rn` across all of lib/ finds zero production callers of isShabbos, isYomTov, or formatHebrewDate outside their own definition file — only test/core/utils/hebrew_calendar_utils_test.dart and one story-acceptance test call isShabbos, testing code nothing else ever runs. Meanwhile lib/features/sacred_time/domain/services/zmanim_window_service.dart implements the real, GeoLocation/zmanim-aware Shabbos+Yom-Tov window (candle-lighting offset, tzais, JewishCalendar.isAssurBemelacha) that actually drives the Sacred Time lock feature — and isShabbos's own doc comment admits its 18:00-local-clock-hour heuristic is inferior ("For precise zmanim... use ComplexZmanimCalendar with a GeoLocation"). Because this dead code lives in core/utils/ (importable by any feature — Rule 1 only blocks core→features, not the reverse) and is unit-tested (making it look supported), a future feature needing "is it Shabbos right now" is one natural-language search away from wiring up the crude, timezone-naive version instead of the correct geo-aware one — and if the caller passes a UTC DateTime (the P5-mandated storage format everywhere else in this codebase), isShabbos's `.hour >= 18` check reads UTC hour, not true local hour, silently wrong for any locale far from UTC.
recommendation: Delete isShabbos, isYomTov, and formatHebrewDate (and their test coverage) from HebrewCalendarUtils. If a lightweight non-geo fallback is genuinely wanted somewhere, rename it to make the approximation explicit (e.g. isApproximateShabbosNoGeo) and doc-link to zmanim_window_service.dart as the source of truth.
acceptance_criteria: `grep -rn "isShabbos\|isYomTov\|formatHebrewDate" learning_tracker/lib/` shows zero references outside sacred_time/ (or the methods are removed entirely).
hebrew_calendar_utils_test.dart's corresponding groups are removed alongside the source methods.

corrections: Downgrade P2→P3: no runtime path uses this code today, so there is no active/concrete cost being paid, only a hypothetical future-misuse scenario. Minor separate nit: the acceptance-criteria grep (isShabbos|isYomTov|formatHebrewDate) will false-positive on step_study_days.dart's unrelated isShabbos widget field — doesn't affect the core finding.
none — evidence and reasoning verified accurate as stated.
